scope: Local point-in-time feature and artifact-contract repair; synthetic verification only
source_publication: Locally committed; no MMG push or deployment

source_identity.algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source after CRLF-to-LF normalization

feature_contract.unknown_labels: Preserved as unknown; extreme future returns retained and flagged

availability.volume_and_guide: Daily-date-end assumption; backward per-item join with 24-hour age limit
availability.metadata: Observed snapshot timestamp; no historical backfill

feature_contract.inference: Separate unlabelled inference artifact; latest completed row per item
feature_contract.construction: Current features and eligible rank/market cohorts are computed before attaching exact-horizon labels; rolling extras use full current history before training-row selection.

artifact_contract.frame_model_pair: Schema, horizon, bar duration and transformation configuration must match
artifact_contract.batch_behavior: An ineligible or nonfinite latest row makes the whole requested batch unavailable; no older-row fallback or invented imputation
artifact_contract.metrics: Require matching model, training-data and bundle identity

verification.scope_note: These are separate runs with overlapping cases, not additive test totals.

limits: Availability conventions are assumptions, not observed ingestion receipts.
Synthetic feature and contract checks do not establish real-data or real-model readiness.
No real dataset rebuild, retraining, metric recomputation, fresh holdout or public MMG deployment.
Historical weights, studies, scores and earlier evidence bundles are unchanged; their performance is not transferable to the new contract.
Earlier browser acceptance covers the per-item validity repair only.
The earlier two-item reproduction remains baseline-only evidence; this file contains no new before/after measurements.
